title: bardolier adopt output
description: What `bardolier adopt` created — the mechanical half of docs/migration-guide.md steps 3-4. cli-spec.md §6 (Projects), phase 30. Additive changes only once the app ships (Phase 5+).

seeded.description: File names written per §10, in write order. Absent under --dry-run.

requested_services.description: Catalogue keys requested by --services, whether or not yet attached.

services.description: Attached services with the host port freshly assigned to each (§5). Empty under --dry-run — a port is not allocated until this runs for real.

path.description: The path given on the command line, resolved to absolute.

dir.description: Where it lands (or, under --dry-run, would land): <project>/work/<basename>.

mode.description: `move` deletes the source once the copy lands; `copy` (the default) leaves it untouched.

bytes.description: Bytes under the source directory — a read-only stat walk, so this is real even under --dry-run.

degraded_roots.description: Present only when a configured root could not be read while this ran (phase 27). Absent under --dry-run, which allocates nothing.

offline_root.description: One unreadable root and how stale bardolier's last look at it is. This block is duplicated verbatim in new/clone/service-add/port-add; test/contracts.test.ts asserts the copies stay identical.

attached_service.description: An attached service: the manifest's host port joined with the catalogue's identity. cli-spec.md §4.1, §4.2, §5. This block is duplicated verbatim in new/clone/service-add/service-remove/service-list; test/contracts.test.ts asserts the copies stay identical.

host_port.description: The debugging tap on the Mac (§5). NOT what the dev app connects to.

data_dir.description: Absolute path of this service's data directory, <project>/data/<key> (phase 19).
